subject.title: fix: filter out transport from stream override check to unblock Codex WS transport

question: Should an explicitly selected OpenClaw runtime remain authoritative when `params.transport` requests WebSocket/SSE, or should that policy intentionally permit Codex runtime substitution?
rationale: The correct repair depends on the permanent ownership contract between OpenClaw runtime selection and Codex transport execution; filtering a marker cannot safely choose that product behavior implicitly.

options.title: Preserve explicit runtime selection
options.body: Keep the embedded-runtime selection and add or clearly reject transport handling within that selected runtime.

options.title: Authorize Codex substitution
options.body: Define and document a typed rule allowing an authored transport policy to select Codex, then prove that Codex receives and applies the selected transport.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit runtime selection
recommendation.body: Keep the embedded-runtime selection and add or clearly reject transport handling within that selected runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked merged request-transport surface is the closest concrete ownership signal for this configuration contract.
